intent: Construct a one-factor comparison, retain whether and the limits of observed clarity, and rebuild both warning clauses without inventing an experimental outcome.
picturePurpose: Code-rendered three-factor controls change the actual learner plan. Named warning slots preserve exact language. Neither generated coin counts nor an attractive water picture may stand in for measured results or drinking-safety evidence.

workshop.title: 只改一项，别越过证据
workshop.instruction: 搭建自己的比较方案，核对观察和推断，再把实验警示的两部分补全。

items.label: 先把原先观察到的结果找准
items.prompt: What result was reported for the original bridge?
items.answer: It held six coins before bending.
items.reason: held six coins before bending是原纸桥的观察。不要改成新折法已承重更多，也不能据此指定第几枚硬币使它弯曲。

items.material:
Mei: Our paper bridge held six coins before bending.
Ben: Shall we change both the paper and the shape?

Teacher: Your water filter looks neat. What did the test show?
Lina: The water looked clearer, but that does not tell us whether it is safe to drink.
Teacher: Exactly. Label it as an experiment and do not drink it.
Lina: I will put that warning beside the display.

Clearer-looking water ____ that it is safe to drink.
The warning has been proposed; Lina has not reported placing it yet. The labels below reconstruct the teacher’s two-part instruction, not a drinking-water safety test.

transfer.stem: Which plan preserves a fair comparison and stays within the observation?
transfer.passage:
NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Ari: The paper helicopter took four seconds to fall in the first timed trial.
Bo: Should we change both the paper type and the wing width?
Ari: Change only the wing width first. Keep the paper type and drop height the same. Then time the new fall.
Bo: The new trial looks steadier, but we have not measured its fall time yet.
Ari: Then we cannot say that it falls for longer just from its appearance.
These are fictional notes for interpreting a fair comparison, not evidence that the learner has performed an experiment. Read as preparation, not a listening score.

options.text: Change only wing width, keep paper type and drop height, and time the new fall before claiming it lasts longer.
Change both paper type and wing width, keep drop height and time the new fall to isolate the effect of wing width.
Change only wing width and keep the other factors, but report a longer fall because it looks steadier.

answer.display: Change only wing width, keep paper type and drop height, and time the new fall before claiming it lasts longer.

explanation.strategy: 先控制只改的一项，再把看到的现象与需要测量的量分开。

steps.text: 只改翼宽，保持纸张类型与下落高度，再给新的一次计时。
steps.reason: 同时改纸张类型和翼宽，就不能把差别单独归到翼宽。

steps.text: 四秒是第一次计时结果；新的一次只是看着更稳，还没有测它的下落时间。
steps.reason: 更稳不等于下落时间更长，不能把外观观察直接写成已证明的时长结论。

distractors.reason: 保持高度并计时是对的，却同时改了纸张类型和翼宽，违背只比较翼宽这一项的条件。
变量控制对，却用看着更稳代替实际计时，把还没测出的更长时长当成结论。

explanation.pitfall: 条件对不等于结论就有依据；原测试的数字、下一次的计划与眼前观察要分清。
